other_conditions: The farmer must cultivate one of the 21 specified horticultural crops.
Registration on the Meri Fasal, Mera Byora portal during the sowing period is mandatory.
Land and crop details must be certified by the Horticulture Department.
Registration is open only during the stipulated period and may be done at designated centers or online.
benefits_summary: The scheme compensates registered horticultural farmers for the price difference up to a protected price for 21 specified crops, with payments made to the farmer's Aadhar‑linked bank account.
documents_required: Land and crop certification by the Horticulture Department
